description.en:
Gives your horses something to do besides being sold.
Every horse gets four competition stats - Stamina, Speed, Agility and Temperament. Each has an inherited ceiling and a trained level: breeding raises what a horse could become, riding and hired staff make it happen. Enter your horses in daily shows and monthly championships for a fee and see the results the next day or month.
Requires Realistic Livestock - Ritter version (FS25_RealisticLivestockRM).
Work in progress: this build only adds the stats and saves them. Training, breeding and competitions follow.
